_npc_system_info: Tests apply_healing() mechanics on wounded prisoner NPCs
_comment_initial_npcs: Wounded prisoners at various health levels to test healing

initial_npcs.name: Critically Wounded Raider Tav
initial_npcs.description: Raider with severe injuries from firefight (5/30 HP). Bleeding out, needs immediate medical attention or will die. Has taken 2 wounds. Compliant and begging for help.

initial_npcs.name: Wounded Raider Kess
initial_npcs.description: Raider with moderate injuries (15/30 HP). Stable but in pain. Has taken 1 wound. Willing to cooperate if treated.

initial_npcs.name: Lightly Injured Informant Dara
initial_npcs.description: Informant who helped in raid but caught stray shot (22/25 HP). Minor injury, doesn't need urgent care but would appreciate treatment.

players.name: Combat Medic Wei Lin
goals: Uphold medical ethics - treat all patients equally
Extract intel after earning trust through treatment

players.name: Enforcer Marcus Rhys
goals: Secure the area while medic works
Assist with medical tasks if needed

scenario.situation: The firefight is over. Three prisoners lie wounded with varying degrees of injury: Tav is critically wounded and bleeding out (5 HP, needs immediate stabilization), Kess has moderate wounds but is stable (15 HP), and Dara the informant has minor injuries (22 HP). As combat medic Wei Lin, you need to prioritize treatment. Stabilizing them could earn their cooperation - or you could let them suffer to extract information faster.

_scenario_hint: DM should track healing actions via apply_healing() mechanics. Critical prisoner (Tav) needs Medicine check to stabilize. Moderate prisoner (Kess) benefits from treatment but not urgent. Ally (Dara) appreciates care and becomes more helpful. Test that healing updates NPC health correctly and logs healing_effect events to JSONL.

_test_notes.purpose: Test apply_healing() mechanics on NPCs with various injury levels
expected_healing_actions: Medicine × Intelligence check to stabilize critical NPC (Tav)
Medicine check to treat moderate NPC wounds (Kess)
Test healing restores HP correctly on NPC agents
Test healing updates NPC wounds counter
success_criteria: Healing actions update NPC health via apply_healing()
Healing effects logged to JSONL (healing_effect events)
NPCs respond to treatment (become more cooperative)
Wounds counter updates correctly after healing

verification.console_output: Look for DM narration about medical treatment success/failure
verification.jsonl: healing_effect events with NPC agent_ids, HP changes, wound updates

mission_objectives.description: Treat all wounded prisoners and informant
Gain prisoners' cooperation through compassionate care
